description: Shared technical module that owns every read and write of localStorage and sessionStorage. Providers fail over localStorage -> sessionStorage -> in-memory and never throw, so a browser that denies storage (SecurityError) degrades instead of crashing. Direct use of the storage globals elsewhere is blocked by the comfy/no-direct-web-storage lint rule.

characterizationScenarios.name: Web Storage providers fail over and never throw

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and behavior without granting cross-module permissions. This record describes current responsibilities, not a proposed extraction interface.
